__doc__: Checkpoints that were RUN on a robot in this registry, first-hand, and what happened. Read by docs/hooks/robot_pages.py
into the 'Policies that ran on this robot' section of every robot page; a robot without a row gets the honest line
'No checkpoint verified on this robot yet'. Every number carries the script or public artifact that produced it in
`source`; a row without a source is refused by tests/test_docs_robot_pages_state_verified_checkpoints.py. Nothing here
is a benchmark score: `result` says what the rollout did, not that a task was performed.

so101.where: sim, laptop (Apple GPU) and NVIDIA L40S
so101.result: 60 of 60 actions applied, 0 errors, 1.2 s inference per 50-action chunk on the laptop, 300 ms on the L40S. Needs the inline native embodiment: the base checkpoint ships no SO-101 stats, so the motion shows the plumbing, not a task
so101.source: docs/start/first-policy.md fence 1 (runs under docs/hooks/check_fences.py); interface sweep 2026-09-28 script sim-policies/03c and issue #4157; policy matrix 2026-09-28 smolvla-01.log

so101.kind: ACT, trained on a real SO-101
so101.where: sim, laptop and L40S; also through the agent tool
so101.result: 300 of 300 actions applied at 30 Hz with embodiment so101 converting degrees to radians, 405 ms per 30-action chunk on the laptop, 15 ms on the L40S; wrist camera routed with obs_rename_override. The report says instruction_read=True for a policy that has no language input (#4159)
so101.source: docs/learn/policies/lerobot-local.md fence (check_fences.py); interface sweep 2026-09-28 script sim-policies/03e-routed and issues #4158, #4159; policy matrix 2026-09-28 act-02.log, tool-01.log

so101.result: embodiment so101 (degrees, gripper 0 to 100) with no joint pinned and no unit warning, 173 ms per 30-action chunk

so101.checkpoint: BFL FLUX 3 Action, SO-101 weights on request
so101.kind: FLUX 3 Action, VLA, 22 GB bf16, provider in review
so101.result: 4,500 of 4,500 actions applied over ten 15 s episodes with 0 errors; zero-shot in the default MuJoCo scene it lifted the cube 0 of 10 times, the converted rest pose sitting at the edge of the checkpoint's calibration window

unitree_g1.checkpoint: NVlabs GR00T-WholeBodyControl G1 (two ONNX files, local directory)
unitree_g1.result: 100 steps at 50 Hz in 2.0 s, 1.7 ms inference, the G1 walked 0.665 m and stayed upright (pelvis 0.793 to 0.747 m); drives 15 of 29 actuators by design, so partial_action_failure_rate reads 0.48 on a healthy rollout. A HuggingFace id fails (#4161; `nvidia/GEAR-SONIC` pre-download): pass the directory
unitree_g1.source: interface sweep 2026-09-28 script sim-policies/06b and issue #4161

unitree_go2.checkpoint: none: builtin benchmark go2_walk_forward with the mock policy
unitree_go2.kind: benchmark plumbing, not a trained policy
unitree_go2.result: evaluate_benchmark ran one episode in 1.19 s and ended it at step 27 of 1000 on the failure clause (the test motion tips the robot), avg_reward 0.49, pass 0 of 1. The scene robot must be spelled unitree_go2: the alias go2 is refused by the benchmark (#4160)
unitree_go2.source: interface sweep 2026-09-28 scripts sim-policies/04 and 04b and issue #4160
